label: Market bars and quotes
implemented_behavior: Polls Yahoo bars and quotes with two-host fallback, timeouts, interval cache and in-flight coalescing; bar intake checks provider symbol identity.
limits: Quote-only path lacks the same identity check; missing provider timestamp reports age zero. No durable immutable market-data store or corporate-action adjustment service.
strategy_coupling: Remove signal-engine imports from downstream consumers; preserve provider adapter and provenance.

label: Completed-bar intake and event deduplication
implemented_behavior: Rejects incoherent OHLC, nonpositive prices, negative volume and unordered bars; drops forming tails and aggregates premarket/regular one-minute bars into five-minute bars. Wire suppresses symbol/bar and eventKey duplicates.
limits: Five-minute aggregation accepts incomplete minute buckets. Event deduplication is bounded local state, not a transactional exactly-once event bus.
strategy_coupling: Replace green event calculation with strategy-free data-change/task events; retain intake and stable event keys.

label: Persistent watchlist and operator-held names
implemented_behavior: Browser watch adoption merges new canonical symbols without replacing prior names. Mark-entered updates the local watch and calls a server held-name endpoint. Worker watch merges roster, last book, tape watch and broker-open names, capped at 36.
current_status: implemented; broker-held discovery halted with Alpaca
limits: Manual held/adopted names are supported. Generic broker position adoption with recovered cost basis, lot identity and independently selected protection is absent.
strategy_coupling: Remove conviction/scanner selection and replace with operator-selected universe plus broker discovery.

label: Market-session scheduling
implemented_behavior: Uses America/New_York date/window helpers and DST offset conversion; separates weekday/weekend and list/card time windows. Tensor workflow offers a thirty-minute wake while local workers use finer polling.
current_status: implemented; scan/publish automation disabled; Tensor schedule retained
limits: Fixed UTC cron is labelled EDT and shifts against local time in standard time. No full exchange holiday/early-close calendar. Workflow success is not delivery proof.
strategy_coupling: Remove scan/publish windows and use configurable task schedules, market calendar and deadlines.

label: Worker startup and recovery
implemented_behavior: Startup revives web server, Tensor, autopilot, watchdog and Echo. PID files are checked against process command lines; watchdog replaces stale autopilot and Echo workers and keeps Tensor alive.
current_status: implemented retained runtime; original-host uptime unverified
limits: No distributed durable queue, work lease, agent registry, checkpointed task ownership or general planning loop. LIVE_CLOCK=zero is not a global halt: startup still invokes the old worker.
strategy_coupling: Remove Tensor/Echo/scan-specific services; keep supervisor contract for strategy-free feed, broker, journal and research-tool workers.

label: Job deadlines and overlap control
implemented_behavior: Runs the heavy scan in a child process with a 95-second budget, SIGTERM then SIGKILL; local scan, guard and wire loops have overlap flags and independent intervals.
limits: A 110-second scan flag clear does not establish that all work stopped. No durable attempt/retry/cancellation state.
strategy_coupling: Replace scanner payload with arbitrary typed task handlers; use real cancellation, persisted attempts and leases.

label: Paper account connection, arm and halt
implemented_behavior: Paper-only adapter verifies account state/equity, detects blocked accounts, persists session equity and applies a three-percent daily account guard. Save/arm/status endpoints honor the hard halt.
limits: Current UI cannot reconnect or arm. New-day day guard automatically arms; model operator disable separately from day-loss parking in a new desk.
strategy_coupling: Remove signal ticket eligibility; preserve paper routing, account truth and explicit risk/arm state.

label: Order submission, retries and bracket intent
implemented_behavior: Submits market or extended-hours limit paper buys with GTC bracket exits and symbol/bar client order IDs. Retries timeout/network/rate-limit/server failures three times.
limits: Successful submit is recorded as sent, not confirmed filled. No complete accepted/partial/filled/rejected/cancelled order state machine or execution stream.
strategy_coupling: Replace bar-driven client IDs with intent IDs and strategy-free order proposal inputs; preserve retry/idempotency adapter.

label: Cancel, flatten and partial close
implemented_behavior: Lists nested open orders, cancels a symbol orders, closes a full position or requests a quantity-limited partial close. Wire records partial-close sent/failed receipts.
limits: Cancel responses are not fully reconciled before close. An accepted close request is not proof of execution; dedicated operator partial-close UI is absent.
strategy_coupling: Remove overhead/impulse exit triggers; retain explicit cancel/close/trim intents and reconciliation.

label: Protective-order coverage repair
implemented_behavior: Reads broker positions/open orders and quantity coverage; for known positions with a local fill or roster plan, replaces missing/undercovered protection with OCO exits. Fractional quantities use a day stop; whole shares use GTC OCO.
limits: Unknown unplanned broker positions are not generically adopted/protected. Checks infer stop/target coverage from order fields and strategy-linked local entries. Fractional positions have day-only stop handling.
strategy_coupling: Remove paperStop/swingStop/paperTarget/swingTarget inference; require operator-approved stop/target intent and broker-execution cost basis.

label: Deterministic paper risk decisions
implemented_behavior: Pure policy helpers calculate quantities and apply open-position, daily-entry, same-story, session-time and same-day re-entry limits, returning hold/buy/sell reasons. Attempts persist as held/failed/sent receipts.
limits: Current policy branches contain source-specific exceptions; Gold handling can treat unknown positions as zero. No portfolio-wide exposure transaction or reservation model.
strategy_coupling: Remove green/Gold/Echo/book eligibility, calibration and technical entry gates; retain generic risk limits with fail-closed unknown state.

label: Broker positions and execution reconciliation
implemented_behavior: Sync refuses to mark the book flat after a failed position read; known positions receive quote marks and exits prefer recent broker sell fills. Adapter retrieves up to 100 recent fill activities.
limits: Latest same-symbol sell is not matched to the current entry/order. Missing exit fill can fall back to quote/lastClose. Full cash/fees/dividends/equity and lot accounting is absent.
strategy_coupling: Remove strategy outcome classification; separate confirmed realized fills from inferred marks and maintain quantity-aware lots.

label: Partial-fill reconstruction and trade review
implemented_behavior: Groups actual broker fill partials within 25-second same-symbol/side bursts and computes quantity-weighted prices, borrowing nearby local order context; pairs same-day buys/sells for review.
current_status: implemented research/review function; current broker intake halted
limits: Burst grouping does not require matching order ID; pairing is same-day by symbol and whole ticket, not partial-quantity lot matching. Overnight accounting is incomplete.
strategy_coupling: Remove signal-specific default stops, targets and success verdicts; use execution IDs and quantity matching for operational reconciliation.

label: Decision and observation journal
implemented_behavior: Typed ledger records entity/action/reason/time, observations, order attempts, timing tape and lifecycle receipts; ID merges and daily/monthly shelves retain history. APIs expose journal projections.
limits: Bounded mutable JSON snapshots and sequential file writes are not an append-only transactional ledger. No task/attempt/actor/artifact lineage fields.
strategy_coupling: Remove scanner/strategy scoring semantics; retain operational event types and add immutable task/order execution lineage.

label: Snapshot restore and two-repository replication
implemented_behavior: Loads and merges local, bundle, primary and backup snapshots; explicit daily vault publishes day/month/current shelves to both repositories. Primary and backup current trees and reviewed modules are identical.
current_status: implemented best-effort; checked-in ledger last saved September 2
limits: Ordinary saveLedger is local/bundle only. Replication success means either copy succeeded; conflict retry does not merge intervening remote records. No guaranteed both-copy freshness.
strategy_coupling: Preserve replication and restore provenance; remove source-specific ledger assumptions and report per-replica results.

label: Notification and publication delivery
implemented_behavior: Telegram adapter returns sent/held/failed status. Typefully adapter creates drafts/schedules with designated-writer gating, duplicate ticker/day checks and required media; external scheduled/published queue is delivery truth.
current_status: Telegram halted; automatic Typefully disabled; manual delivery code retained
limits: No guaranteed delivery or transactional outbox. Clock assert can succeed while cards remain owed. UI Mark sent changes local status without external confirmation.
strategy_coupling: Remove ticker-card editorial doctrine, scanner names and signal notifications; retain configurable operational alerts, approved research delivery and external acknowledgements.

label: Operator console and manual controls
implemented_behavior: UI offers watch/held management, observation marking, paper arm/status, research runs, draft editing/copy/send and review views; server endpoints provide roster and ledger projections.
current_status: implemented; paper controls refuse while halted
limits: Browser autopilot toggle does not stop backend workers. General task approve/pause/cancel and per-agent control APIs are absent. Membership tiers/prices are local CRUD/static copy.
strategy_coupling: Remove strategy charts/scanners/sales tiers; expose task, broker, journal and tool controls with server acknowledgements.

label: Heartbeats, health receipts and operator metrics
implemented_behavior: Workers stamp heartbeats; desk-ops logs dated health slots/grades and review completion; OperatorStrip polls clock/render/card/queue summaries every twenty seconds.
current_status: implemented; displayed health is partly inferred/static
limits: renderer=true is literal; clock on means same-day lastScanAt and disabled runCycle also stamps it. Workflow success proves completion only, not live process health, fills or delivery.
strategy_coupling: Remove strategy-specific health grades; show independent process heartbeat, last useful work, feed freshness, broker reconciliation and task delivery states.

label: Deterministic research compilation and artifacts
implemented_behavior: Analyst runner compiles observations, daily reviews and X quality into persisted report/feedback JSON. Daily review/clock review functions store dated artifacts and decision receipts.
current_status: implemented tooling; not an autonomous research agent
limits: No generic research-task queue, agent reasoning loop, experiment execution sandbox or artifact approval lifecycle. Existing analytics are specialized to scanner/trade outcome data.
strategy_coupling: Remove signal-specific inferred weights, walk-forward filters and scanner rankings; retain tool-run inputs/outputs, data summaries, lineage and operational review artifacts.
